description: This file contains functions for rendering XML documentation comments and text from Markdown nodes, specifically for .NET XML documentation generation within a Playwright-related project.

methods.name: renderXmlDoc
methods.description: Generates XML documentation comments from Markdown nodes, wrapping summary and remarks sections with a specified prefix.

methods.name: _innerRenderNodes
methods.description: Processes Markdown nodes to produce structured summary and remarks sections, handling list items, code blocks, and notes.

methods.name: _wrapCode
methods.description: Escapes special characters in code lines and formats them for XML documentation.

methods.name: _wrapInNode
methods.description: Wraps given nodes in specified XML tags and appends to the target array.

methods.name: _wrapAndEscape
methods.description: Converts Markdown node text into escaped and formatted lines suitable for XML documentation, handling links and code formatting.

methods.name: _nodeShouldBeIgnored
methods.description: Determines if a Markdown node should be ignored based on its content.

methods.name: renderTextOnly
methods.description: Extracts plain text summary from Markdown nodes, ignoring formatting.
